query: What features can be extracted to train a model to predict a review's score?

per_column.name: avg_word_length
per_column.rationale: Stylistic feature of the review text, computable before knowing the score; weak but legitimate signal.

per_column.name: capitalized_word_count
per_column.rationale: Text-derived feature independent of the score; may capture emphasis/tone.

per_column.name: exclamation_count
per_column.rationale: Punctuation feature plausibly correlated with enthusiasm/rating; not a restatement of score.

per_column.name: has_product_mention
per_column.rationale: Almost entirely constant (9934 zeros vs 66 ones), so it carries essentially no discriminative signal.

per_column.name: helpfulness_ratio
per_column.rationale: Derived from helpfulness votes, external to the score; weak but plausible predictor and not leakage of the score itself.

per_column.name: negative_word_count
per_column.rationale: Lexicon-based sentiment count from text; genuinely predictive of rating and not a restatement of the numeric score.

per_column.name: positive_word_count
per_column.rationale: Positive sentiment lexicon count is a strong, legitimate predictor of review score.

per_column.name: question_mark_count
per_column.rationale: Punctuation feature from text; weak but valid predictive signal, not leakage.

per_column.name: summary_length
per_column.rationale: Length of summary text, knowable pre-outcome; weak stylistic predictor.

per_column.name: text_length
per_column.rationale: Review length is a legitimate feature that can correlate with rating extremity/verbosity.

per_column.name: word_count
per_column.rationale: Token count of text; valid, though redundant with text_length, it remains a legitimate predictor.

judge.rationale: None of the columns restate or leak the score, so this is a clean feature-engineering set. The sentiment lexicon counts (positive_word_count, negative_word_count) provide the strongest genuine predictive leverage for review score, and helpfulness_ratio adds external signal. The remaining stylistic/punctuation/length features are legitimate but individually weak and partially redundant (text_length vs word_count vs summary_length). has_product_mention is near-constant and effectively useless. Overall the set gives moderate predictive leverage beyond the original columns, driven mainly by sentiment counts.
